name: Fortune Tellers And Psychics
overview: Scripture strictly forbids engaging with fortune tellers, psychics, and those who practice divination or have familiar spirits, as these practices are considered abominations before the LORD. The Law commands believers not to seek or learn from such individuals, warning that involvement with them leads to defilement and severe judgment, including being cut off from the people or even death. These commands emphasize God’s holiness and the danger of turning away from Him to seek guidance through occult means.
